description: Manifest of reference repositories cloned as siblings to arcon/. Not tracked as git submodules by design (see docs/ARCON_MASTER_PLAN.md) -- these are read-only reference material for Arcon's design work, not Arcon dependencies. Run scripts/clone-reference-repos.sh on a new machine to restore them at the same relative paths.
